# Security policy

Please do not open a public issue for a vulnerability that could expose private evidence, local paths, credentials, or operator data.

Report security concerns privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/aa-on-ai/clawbotomy/security/advisories/new). Include the affected commit, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation.

Clawbotomy is research-preview software. A checkup records one synthetic session and does not certify an agent or authorize production access.
